g.text: Illustrated board; JA inset is a connector reference, not a drilling template.
U1: FPGA 3.3 V -> LED 5 V data
U2: HDMI 5 V -> Due 3.3 V status
R6 / R7: 10k NES DATA pull-ups to JA6
Illustrative assembly - build internal wiring from sheets 02 and 03.
Silver button -> HDMI switch directly. D9 is unused.
HDMI 5 V status -> U2 -> Due D8 controls exclusive input routing.
JA6 feeds only R6/R7 NES pull-ups; external 5 V powers LEDs.
Pi 4B artwork is illustrative: actual Pi model is unspecified.
Nexys Video / trackball / interface artwork is illustrative.
JA pin numbers and internal assembly wiring: see sheets 02 / 03.
